evidence.title: Sanpete County hits pause on data centers for 6 months
evidence.supports: Confirms solar farm development is governed by a SEPARATE, earlier six-month moratorium adopted in June 2026, distinct from this August 4, 2026 data-center moratorium.
evidence.quote: The county's action mirrors a six-month moratorium on commercial solar farm development approved by commissioners in June. County officials said at the time that the temporary pause would allow planners to complete an ordinance governing utility-scale solar projects before applications could be submitted under existing county code.

decisions.notes: SECTOR_CHECK resolved as no change: solar is regulated by a separate, earlier-adopted moratorium (June 2026); this row's August 4, 2026 moratorium covers only data center development. sectors stays ["data_center"].
